## Checklist

- [ ] Gates run locally: `ruff check backend tests scripts`, `mypy --platform darwin` and `--platform win32`, `scripts/secret_scan.py`, `pytest -m "not integration and not network"`, and frontend `tsc -b --noEmit`, `npm test` and `npm run build` when `frontend/` changed
- [ ] NOT-PROVEN is stated above. Nothing is presented as a pass without evidence
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data, company names or tenant hosts in the diff or the commit messages
- [ ] No attribution lines in commit messages or files (no co-author trailers for tools or assistants, no "generated by" footers)
- [ ] Migrations are linear (one Alembic head) and back up before upgrading
- [ ] Docs updated: ADRs, `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_COVERAGE.md`, runbooks and the `[Unreleased]` section of `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Protected paths touched (AGENTS.md) are named, and they had special review
